description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of morphosyntactic probing across various model configurations, including unperturbed trained models and models with different perturbations applied to their layers. The horizontal axis displays the model configurations, arranged left-to-right: the first two categories are “embedding” and “1st layer,” followed by seven “random layers” variants (labeled “random layers,” “random layers +B₂,” “random layers +L₂,” “random layers +R₂,” “random layers +permute”), then five “random” variants (labeled “random,” “random +B₂,” “random +L₂,” “random +R₂,” “random +permute”), and finally the “unperturbed” model. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 70 to 95 on a linear scale. The bars are color-coded according to the model type: light blue bars represent the “embedding” and “1st layer” probes; light green bars represent “random layers” models with pre-trained embedding layers; red bars represent “random” models with random embedding layers; and orange bars represent the “unperturbed” models. The “embedding” and “1st layer” bars (blue) show accuracies of approximately 80 and 82, respectively. The “random layers” bars (green) are clustered around 80, with values ranging from approximately 79.5 to 81. The “random” bars (red) are all clustered between approximately 71 and 73. The “unperturbed” bars (orange) are the tallest, with values approximately 90 and 92. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order specified in the caption. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and height.
